instructions: Lie on your right side on a mat with your legs extended and stacked, your right arm on the floor in front of you for support and your left hand resting lightly behind your head.
Exhale as you lift your left elbow and your left leg towards each other, crunching your left side while keeping your hips stacked.
Pause for a second at the top, feeling your obliques contract.
Inhale as you slowly lower your elbow and leg back to the starting position, then repeat and switch sides.
